grammar.title: Expressing Opinions — I think / In my opinion / I'd say
rules: "I think (that)" introduz opiniões pessoais: I think this movie is amazing.
"In my opinion," geralmente vem no início da frase, seguida de vírgula: In my opinion, the plot was too slow.
"I'd say" (I would say) suaviza a opinião e soa mais casual: I'd say the acting was fantastic.
